glosses: Of plants, especially trees, that do not shed their leaves seasonally.

glosses: Continually fresh or self-renewing.
Being a clause which causes an automatic renewal of a contract unless action is taken.
Continually fresh or self-renewing.
Of a document, a piece of software, or a data set: kept continually up to date (as opposed to being published at regular intervals and outdated in the meantime)

examples.text: Chrome and Firefox are evergreen browsers: they update automatically and version numbers are only used for internal reference.

glosses: Suitable for transmission at any time; not urgent or time-dependent.

examples.text: Another change in the news was emphasis on “evergreen” features involving attractive children or animals, parades or fireworks, as well as local developments.

glosses: A conifer tree.

examples.text: The spruce and fir trees crowded to the track on each side to welcome us, the arbor- vitae, with its changing leaves, prompted us to make haste, and the sight of the canoe-birch gave us spirits to do so.
